description: Brand-name detection list for the Part 12 firewall. The chatbot refuses queries that name a specific brand and strips brand names from model output. List is conservative (well-known CPG brands in categories where heavy-metals questions are common) and case-insensitive matched at word boundaries. Add brands as they appear in user queries. False positives are preferable to leaks: a refusal that names an unrelated brand can be corrected; a leaked brand recommendation cannot be undone.
category_note: Brands grouped by product category for ease of curation; the runtime detector treats the entire list as a flat set.
